notablePrerequisites: Gemstone Array has at least one charge counter on it.
description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Inexorable Tide triggers, putting a charge counter on Gemstone Array.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
